title: Bramble Union Villages
kicker: Vibrant, painted, moss-lit Bramble Union communities camouflaged behind mudstone walls and thorn protection.
hook: Vibrant, painted, moss-lit Bramble Union communities camouflaged behind mudstone walls and thorn protection.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Bramble Union villages are vibrant behind protection: painted mudstone, thorn screens, moss lamps, and people tired of being scenery in someone else's route.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Behind walls of trained thorn and painted mudstone, a whole village hides in plain sight. Gardens and repair-fires and children's paths fill the space within. Salvaged ward-charms get sorted and re-strung in a scrap yard. Watchers in the lookout trees see...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Food is shared and stretched, root gardens, edible weeds, lean chickens, a stew that has plainly been added to for days. A guest gets a full bowl even when the bowl is thin, because pride here is fed before bellies are.
